# Donadomains MCP

> Free MCP server giving AI agents real-time domain availability, multi-registrar price comparison, WHOIS/RDAP intel, and AI valuation. Works in any MCP client that supports the Streamable HTTP transport.

Connect: https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp
Full docs: https://www.donadomains.xyz/docs
Source: https://github.com/adipundir/donadomains

## Install

Add this to your MCP client's server config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "donadomains": {
      "url": "https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

No signup, no API key. Compatible with any client supporting the Streamable HTTP transport — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai web Connectors, Cursor, Continue, Windsurf, Zed.

## Tools

### 1. check_domain_availability(domain)

Check if a domain is available right now. If available, returns the lowest price and the registrar offering it. If taken, returns ownership info (registrar, dates, nameservers, status). Works for every TLD including .sh, .io, .ac via port-43 WHOIS fallback.

### 2. search_domains(keyword, limit?, tldFilter?, includeTaken?)

Search a keyword across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun). Returns available domains with prices, sorted by relevance, exact-match priority, registrar coverage, popular TLDs, and price.

### 3. get_domain_info(domain)

Deep WHOIS / RDAP / DNS intel for a registered domain — registrar, creation/expiry dates, nameservers, registrant (if not privacy-protected), DNSSEC, ICANN status codes. Postgres-cached, repeat lookups sub-100ms.

### 4. valuate_domain(domain, registered?, isPremium?, registrationPrice?)

AI-powered domain valuation (Gemini under the hood). Returns score 0-100, tier (common/decent/premium/ultra), USD price range, reasoning, and 3-6 per-factor analyses. Cached server-side forever — repeat valuations are free.

## Rate Limits (free, per source IP)

IPv6 addresses are normalized to their /64 prefix before being counted (so attackers can't rotate the lower 64 bits).

- Overall MCP frames: 200 / hour
- check_domain_availability / get_domain_info: 60 / hour each
- search_domains: 20 / hour (scrapes 6 registrars)
- valuate_domain: 20 / hour (Gemini on cache miss; repeats are free)

Limits are per rolling-hour window from your first request. Going over returns an error your AI can read and explain.

## Example prompts

- "Is ad402.sh available? When does it expire?"
- "Find me a cheap .io domain for a craft-beer brand under $20/yr."
- "Who owns github.com and when does it expire?"
- "What's crypto.com roughly worth?"
